C:S1.1.text: Booking Holdings runs five operating brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, and OpenTable. Priceline is known in the U.S. for its "Name Your Own Price" model, Agoda is strong in Asia-Pacific, and KAYAK is a metasearch service.

C:S2.1.text: OpenTable handles restaurant reservations on an agency-based business model, earning commissions and transaction fees.

C:S3.1.text: Agency model: Booking connects travelers with providers and earns a commission. The property collects the payment, so Booking is acting as an intermediary.

C:S4.1.text: Merchant model: Booking collects the traveler's payment and pays the property.

C:S5.1.text: Advertising and other: This includes metasearch advertising from KAYAK and sponsored placement fees from hotels.
